answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 35763 Country: India Title: Namaz me satr dikhe ga to nmaz ho ya nahi or waju tute gi ya nahi tute gi? Question: Namaz me satr dikhe ga to nmaz ho ya nahi or waju tute gi ya nahi tute gi? Answer ID: 35763 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 75/62/B=1433) Salah shall not be valid if one fourth of any satr (body part i.e. ear or waist, whose covering is wajib in salah) is uncovered in any rukn of salah equal to a time in which one can recite three tasbih. And if it happened at the time of starting salah then also the salah shall not be valid. ويمنع حتى انعقادها كشف ربع عضو قدر أداء كركن بلا صنعه (درمختار) وفي الشامي: وذلك قدر ثلاث تسبيحات (2/75زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
